text.tspan: Comparison of the Living Planet Index across reports
The Living Planet Index (LPI) measures the average decline in monitored wildlife populations, where values in
1970 are equal to 100. The LPI published in the 2022 and 2024 report are shown for comparison.
Data source: World Wildlife Fund and Zoological Society of London (2022; 2024)
